acceptanceCriteria.text: Enumerate the Route 1 external runtime prerequisites actually required by supported CLI/MCP behavior and map each to an explicit Route 2 Nix dependency or documented lower-level system prerequisite.
`rg` and any equivalent required executable are available from the Nix/managed Runtime closure without relying on host PATH.
Route 2 builds from the canonical Route 1 payload identity established by #751.
A hermetic functional smoke exercises at least one real Mottainai CLI operation that needs external runtime tooling, not only `--version`.
A hermetic MCP stdio smoke starts the packaged Route 2 MCP entrypoint and completes a bounded protocol interaction.
Removing a declared runtime dependency causes the focused Route 2 acceptance test to fail.
Managed-generation health/evidence reports the exact package/generation identity used for the functional smoke.
Documentation states the exact Route 2 precondition and what dependencies are closed by Nix versus intentionally remaining host/kernel prerequisites.

issue.title: feat(runtime): close the Route 2 Nix Runtime dependency and readiness contract
